name: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant Country Breakfast: Scrambled Eggs, Buttermilk Pancakes & Hot Biscuits
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Mrs. Knott's opens early for breakfast before the park gates open: fluffy scrambled eggs, bacon, country potatoes, buttermilk pancakes, and hot buttermilk biscuits with seedless Boysenberry Jelly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Two-Egg Breakfast or Buttermilk Pancakes with bacon and hot biscuits—use smooth Boysenberry Syrup or Seedless Boysenberry Jelly (skip whole-berry preserves).
watchOuts: Skip the Boysenberry Pork Sausage if spiced sausage bothers you, and choose bacon or ham instead
